_comment: Warren NAT-PMP port forwarding: RFC 6886 frames plus the three Warren extensions an SDK must reproduce byte for byte. (1) result codes 6 SuggestedPortUnavailable and 7 RateLimited, which RFC 6886 has no equivalent for because it lets a server substitute a port where Warren refuses. (2) the RateLimitInfo response trailer, 4 bytes after the 16-byte Map response. (3) the credential trailer on a Map request, 4-byte header then an opaque body, which buys one forwarded port (warren-core doc 99). Every trailer is length-gated on parse, so a peer that ignores it reads the frame exactly as an RFC-only peer would.

requests.name: external_address_request
requests._comment: GET PUBLIC ADDRESS (RFC 6886 3.2): version, opcode 0, no payload.

requests.name: map_udp_request
requests._comment: MAP UDP (3.3): internal 8080, suggested external 50000, lifetime 3600.

requests.name: map_tcp_request_release
requests._comment: Delete-mapping (3.3.2): lifetime 0 and suggested external 0 on the live tuple.

requests.name: map_tcp_request_server_picks
requests._comment: Suggested external 0 = the server picks the port.

credential_requests.name: map_udp_request_with_credential
credential_requests._comment: map_udp_request, then the credential trailer: magic 0x5747, length 8 big endian, then the opaque body. The 12 RFC bytes in front are untouched.

credential_requests.name: map_udp_request_empty_credential
credential_requests._comment: A zero-length credential is still a well-formed trailer, and reads back as an empty slice rather than as no credential at all.

malformed_credential_trailers.name: wrong_magic
malformed_credential_trailers._comment: Trailing bytes that are not a credential (padding, a probe, a future extension) must read as no credential, never as a refused request.

malformed_credential_trailers.name: header_truncated
malformed_credential_trailers._comment: Two trailing bytes cannot even hold the 4-byte header.

responses.name: map_response_success
responses._comment: 3.3.1 with no Warren trailer: an RFC-only or pre-trailer server.

responses.name: map_response_success_with_rate_limit
responses._comment: Same grant, plus the 4-byte trailer: 3 attempts left, window resets in 900 s. Byte 1 of the trailer is reserved and zero.

responses.name: map_response_suggested_port_unavailable
responses._comment: Warren result code 6: the pinned port is held by somebody else. External port and lifetime are 0, so a client cannot read a refusal as a grant.

responses.name: map_response_rate_limited
responses._comment: Warren result code 7: retry after the trailer's window_reset_secs (137 s here), with no attempts left.

responses.name: map_response_out_of_resources
responses._comment: RFC result code 4: the per-client port quota, or an exhausted pool.
